Comment: Engineering Modernization Hub - modernization run state machine. Most phases are still Pass-state stubs (Fase 1) that only record the phase name and a placeholder status update; real Lambda/ECS integrations arrive phase by phase in Fases 2-4 per PLAN.md. Baseline (task 2.3/2.3-tf) is the first real integration: a genuine arn:aws:states:::ecs:runTask.sync against the sandbox-network Terraform module. This file is rendered through Terraform's templatefile() (see ../main.tf) - the ${...} placeholders in the Baseline state are substituted with real ARNs/IDs at plan/apply time, they are not literal JSON values.

FetchRepo.Comment: Fase 2 (2.2/2.2-tf): becomes a Task invoking lambda fetch_repo, which downloads the tarball at the requested SHA and writes ws/v0 to S3.

Baseline.Comment: Task 2.3/2.3-tf. Real ECS RunTask.sync against the sandbox-network module's Fargate task definition, running the unit_tests check against ws/v0 - baseline only confirms the repo's own tests pass before any change is made (PLAN.md 2.3: 'baseline solo confirma que los tests propios del repo pasan antes de cualquier cambio'). The sandbox task definition bakes in NO environment variables (CLAUDE.md invariant #8), so check-specific input is supplied here, at invocation time, via ContainerOverrides only. ASSUMPTION - FLAGGED, depends on a parallel task's output not yet available when this was authored (no sandbox/entrypoint.py or sandbox/README.md existed in the repo at authoring time): the sandbox image's entrypoint (1) selects which check to run from a CHECK_NAME environment variable, and (2) reads/writes its workspace and JUnit result via presigned S3 URLs (never AWS credentials - the sandbox has none) passed as the WORKSPACE_GET_URL and JUNIT_PUT_URL environment variables. Those two URLs are assumed to be produced by the FetchRepo phase and threaded through as $.phase_result.workspace_get_url / $.phase_result.junit_put_url (FetchRepo's own ResultPath is $.phase_result, so this is the first field Baseline can read). If the real sandbox entrypoint expects a different contract (e.g. a command override instead of env vars, or a different field path for the URLs), only this state's Parameters.Overrides needs to change to match - nothing else in this state machine depends on the exact shape.

DiscoveryPlan.Comment: Fase 3 (3.3-tf/3.4): becomes a Task invoking lambda agent_phase (Strands + Bedrock Haiku) for discovery, impact analysis and plan; computes plan_hash.

AwaitApproval.Comment: PLACEHOLDER ARN. Fase 4 (4.3): becomes a real callback integration using arn:aws:states:::lambda:invoke.waitForTaskToken, paused until POST /runs/{id}/approval performs the conditional write (sub = requested_by, state = AWAITING_APPROVAL, plan_hash match, recent auth) and calls SendTaskSuccess/SendTaskFailure. Today this Resource ARN does not exist and this state is never actually executed end-to-end.

Implement.Comment: Fase 3 (3.8): becomes a Task invoking lambda agent_phase (Strands + Bedrock Sonnet) writing code/tests within writable_paths, through the policy gate.

Verify.Comment: Fase 2/3 (2.3-tf sandbox + 3.8 fix loop): becomes a Task running the sandbox checks (install/unit_tests/lint) and, on failure, looping back to Implement up to max_iterations.

CoreOps.Comment: Fase 2 (2.5/2.6-tf): becomes a Task invoking lambda core_ops, which computes the final verdict from real JUnit only - never from model output (CLAUDE.md invariant #1).
